findings.title: Mismatch trimming can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
findings.body: When reporting an HTML mismatch, the code computes a common prefix (`start`) and common suffix (`end`) independently and then calls `value.substring(start, value.length() - end)` and `sanitized.substring(start, sanitized.length() - end)`. If the common prefix and suffix overlap (for example when one string is the other string plus repeated characters, such as `value="aa"` and `sanitized="aaa"`), `start` can be greater than `length - end`, causing a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. This would abort the verifier with an obscure stack trace instead of reporting a validation message.

findings.title: Message properties are read with ISO-8859-1 instead of UTF-8
findings.body: `new PropertyResourceBundle(fis)` reads the input stream using the ISO-8859-1 charset (via `Properties.load(InputStream)`), while Keycloak message bundles are UTF-8 and the same file is earlier read with `Files.readString`, which defaults to UTF-8. Non-ASCII translations may therefore be misinterpreted, causing false positives, false negatives, or confusing validation failures in the HTML sanitizer. A UTF-8 `Reader` should be used when constructing the bundles.

findings.title: Choice-format normalization bypasses HTML validation
findings.body: `normalizeValue()` replaces the entire `{n,choice,...}` construct with `...` for keys such as `linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit*` and `error-invalid-multivalued-size` before HTML sanitization. Any HTML placed inside the choice alternatives is therefore never checked by the OWASP sanitizer. If these messages are rendered as HTML, a malicious or malformed translation can smuggle markup through these keys despite the PR’s stated goal of sanitizing translated message resources.

findings.title: Lithuanian account message contains Italian text
findings.body: `totpStep1` in the Lithuanian account messages was changed to `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see Italian instructions in the account console.

findings.title: Lithuanian login message contains Italian text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` in the Lithuanian login messages was changed to `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see Italian instructions on the login page.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese locale uses Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: `totpStep1` in `messages_zh_CN.properties` uses Traditional Chinese characters such as `手機上安裝以下應用程式之一`, while the `zh_CN` locale is Simplified Chinese. The translation should use Simplified Chinese wording.

findings.title: JUnit 5 tests may not run because Surefire/JUnit engine is not configured
findings.body: The module declares `junit-jupiter-api` but no `junit-jupiter-engine` or other test runtime, and the `maven-surefire-plugin` is declared without a version or explicit JUnit 5 configuration. With Maven defaults, the new JUnit Jupiter tests may be silently skipped, so the added verifier tests may not actually protect the build.
